artifact:
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: Log onset and reset of low pressure alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the inspiratory pressure is below the threshold
    Then the low pressure alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be logged as onset
    When the inspiratory pressure is above the threshold
    Then the low pressure alarm should be reset
    And the alarm should be logged as reset

  Scenario: Trigger low pressure alarm with high priority
    Given the system is initialized
    When the inspiratory pressure is below the threshold
    Then the low pressure alarm should be triggered with high priority

  Scenario: Automatically reset low pressure alarm upon first breath with inspiration pressure above threshold
    Given the system is initialized
    When the inspiratory pressure is below the threshold for 3 consecutive breaths
    Then the low pressure alarm should be triggered
    When the inspiratory pressure is above the threshold on the first breath
    Then the low pressure alarm should be reset

  Scenario Outline: Compute "pressure high" alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the inspiratory pressure is above the threshold for 3 consecutive breaths
    Then the pressure high alarm should be triggered
    When the inspiratory pressure is below the threshold on the first breath
    Then the pressure high alarm should be reset
    Examples:
      | threshold | breaths |
      | 10        | 3       |
      | 15        | 3       |
      | 20        | 3       |

  Scenario: Emit sound while "pressure high" alarm is active
    Given the system is initialized
    When the inspiratory pressure is above the threshold for 3 consecutive breaths
    Then the pressure high alarm should be triggered
    And a sound should be emitted
    When the inspiratory pressure is below the threshold on the first breath
    Then the pressure high alarm should be reset
    And the sound should stop

  Scenario: Display "pressure high" alarm until cancelled even if inactive
    Given the system is initialized
    When the inspiratory pressure is above the threshold for 3 consecutive breaths
    Then the pressure high alarm should be triggered
    When the inspiratory pressure is below the threshold on the first breath
    Then the pressure high alarm should be reset
    When the alarm is cancelled
    Then the pressure high alarm should be displayed until cancelled

  Scenario: Support alarm state where alarm is visible but not audible
    Given the system is initialized
    When the alarm is set to visible but not audible
    Then the alarm should be visible but not audible

  Scenario: PIP too high alarm has high priority
    Given the system is initialized
    When the PIP is above the threshold
    Then the PIP too high alarm should be triggered with high priority

  Scenario: Default value for "PIP too high" alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the commanded PIP is 10 cm H2O
    Then the default value for the PIP too high alarm should be 15 cm H2O
